section.heading: 6.2. Integration by Substitution
section.paragraph: In Section 6.1, we developed certain rules of integration that are closely related to the corresponding rules of differentiation in Chapters 3 and 5. In this section, we introduce a method of integration called the method of substitution, which is related to the chain rule for differentiating functions. When used in conjunction with the rules of integration developed earlier, the method of substitution is a powerful tool for integrating a large class of functions.
